test_downcast: test the pybind11 tag-based polymorphic downcast by creating a zoo of animals and verifying correct type resolution
run_create_zoo: run create_zoo to build a list of polymorphic animals including Labrador, Dog, Chihuahua, Cat, and Panther
test_bark_method: test the bark method on dog-type animals in the zoo to verify polymorphic behavior and custom sound output
test_purr_method: test the purr method on cat-type animals in the zoo to verify polymorphic behavior and sound output
review_excitement_attribute: review the excitement attribute on Labrador instances to verify mutable property access through polymorphic downcast
